game_concept: A racing platformer set in Coastal Port – Tidepool Cove, a tidepool cove: the dock cartographer must handle kraken tentacles while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Gatekeeper If: Write a single if condition that opens the gate only for friendly visitors.
theme: Coastal Port – Tidepool Cove: a tidepool cove
core_gameplay_loop: In Tidepool Cove, repeat each round: Write a single if condition that opens the gate only for friendly visitors. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the dock cartographer ahead. Then check the gate_integrity value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the lighthouse lamp by solving code steps involving gate_integrity that move the dock cartographer forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.6).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the lighthouse lamp first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 3 (intro tier): Gatekeeper If
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Gatekeeper If' (Week 3 slot 1), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Tidepool Cove'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gate_integrity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against kraken tentacles in Tidepool Cove.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.6).
